title: Stochastic epidemic models with pulse vaccination, varying infectivity and waning immunity
summary: We introduce a fully stochastic, non-Markovian SIRS-type epidemic model that incorporates varying infectivity, waning immunity and a pulse vaccination strategy that may not confer permanent immunity. The model is constructed at the individual level, where each person is characterized by random infectivity and susceptibility functions, and vaccination campaigns occur at the jump times of a Poisson random measure with arbitrary intensity.
